content.title: Explore Offset’s Lavish Jewelry Collection
content.text: Kiari Kendrell Cephus (born December 14, 1991), renowned by his stage name Offset, is a former member of the popular hip-hop group Migos. He is one of the main reasons why Migos became a fan favorite during their peak years. Other than his musical talent, Offset is famous for his fashion. A big part of his signature style is his jewelry collection. Starting from jaw-dropping pendants to extravagant pinky rings, Offset’s jewelry collection is nothing short of ‘envious’. No wonder he became an inspiration for young fashion enthusiasts in no time. In this article, we are going to dive deeper into Offset’s fabulous jewelry collection and discuss some of his most precious jewelry pieces. Offset’s Chains The Raindrop Chain Following the success of the hit single Bad and Boujee, the former Migos member copped a lavish piece of jewelry, which is inspired by the song’s opening verse ‘Raindrops/Drop tops.’ The raindrop chain is fully made of diamond, with a pendant shaped like an actual raindrop. This impressive piece of jewelry was designed and created by the popular Eliot Avianne, the founder of Avianne & Co. Jewelers. It is rumored that the raindrop chain set Offset back about $100,000, which is understandable, as diamonds don’t come cheap. For the raindrop-shaped pendant, 35 carat diamonds were used, while the link was made with 65 carat diamonds in total. Offset House Chain The Offset House Chain is special, and for more than one reason. This unique piece of jewelry was a Valentine’s Day gift from Cardi B. On top of that, it is a reminder of the early days of Migos, when they released ‘Bando.’ ‘Bando’ is a slang term for an abandoned house, and Cardi B’s gift looks exactly like that. In fact, there is a door in this miniature house that can actually be opened. If you open it, you’ll find some tiny action figures. Like the Raindrop Chain, this piece is also made by Eliot Avianne. This special diamond chain is confirmed to be around the $250,000 price point. Big Stone Tennis Chain The former Migos member is a fan of expressive jewelry, and his expensive Big Stone Tennis Chain is a testament to his signature style. This $150,000 chain has large diamonds, in a tennis-style setting. To describe this piece, the rapper uttered, “Big, big, big….”- reinstating his favoritism towards attention-grabbing jewelry pieces. Offset’s Cuban Link Necklaces Offset has a special liking for cuban link necklaces. Almost in every live show he performs in, he is seen wearing a bunch of cuban link necklaces with a wide variety of pendants. In an interview with GQ , the rapper himself confessed that he has lots of cuban link necklaces, both thick and thin. Among his big collection of cuban link necklaces, The Yellow Cuban from Eliot, the Baguette, the Franco Cuban Chain, and the Golden Prong Set is most notable. They are priced within the range of $45,000 to $150,000. Offset’s Pendants If there is one thing without which Offset’s outfit is incomplete, it has to be a flamboyant pendant. Here are some of Offset’s luxurious pendants: The ‘Offset’ Pendant This one is called the ‘Offset’ pendant for a very obvious reason. This pendant is basically a diamond carving of the term ‘Offset.’ This is the rapper and songwriter’s one of the most favorite pieces, as he is seen wearing this beautiful pendant quite frequently. Apart from sparkling diamonds, this iced out pendant also has gemstones. Other than symbolizing Offset’s identity, the ‘Offset’ pendant looks absolutely gorgeous. Priced at $60,000, the ‘Offset’ pendant is a great addition to the rapper’s amazing collection of jewelry pieces. Expensive Jesus Pendant Offset spent the most difficult time of his life in jail. He spent eight months in jail in 2015 due to felony charges associated with drugs and weapons. The rapper later confessed that faith in god helped him pass this difficult stage of his life. This is why the Expensive Jesus Pendant is really special for the rapper. Priced at $25,000, this pendant is definitely not among the most expensive pieces of jewelry the rapper owns. However, its value goes way beyond the amount of money Offset actually had to pay for it. This pendant is an elegant face of Jesus Christ, encrusted with diamonds. This piece symbolizes Offset coming out of his struggling days by keeping his faith in God. Two Tone Cross Pendant When it comes to expressing his faith in God, Offset is simply something special. His Two Tone Cross Pendant is just proof of that. This elegant pendant is made of white and rose gold, with a diamond topping. There is a pink stone at the intersection of the cross. Priced at $220,000, this is one of the most expensive pendants in Offset’s collection. In fact, this might be among the most expensive crosses in the world. In an interview with GQ, Offset admitted that this Two Tone Cross Pendant is one of his most favorite jewelry pieces. Icecartel's Custom Pendants Offset’s Watches Offset never disappoints when it comes to styling, and his watch collection acts as a great addition to his wardrobe. Here are some of his noteworthy watches: Patek Philippe Nautilus Chronograph This is by no means any ordinary watch. Apart from the fact that it costs $120,000, it will grab anyone’s attention because of its dazzling rose gold color. This glitzy watch comes with a baguette style dial and bezel. The former Migos member loves to stand out from the crowd, and he sure did that with this luxury watch. Other than the one Offset owns, only four of these watches were produced. Iced Out Richard Mille Watch If you think the Patek Philippe watch was expensive, then the Richard Mille watch will blow your mind. Offset gifted this elegant watch to his wife Cardi B on her birthday. When it comes to buying gifts for his wife, money is no object to Offset. He didn’t mind paying $220,000 for this rare watch. Even though technically this watch belongs to Cardi B, Offset said on screen that the couple doesn’t mind sharing each other’s jewelry. That’s why we included this watch in this list. The rapper also said that Richard Mille watches gain more value over time, so it can be considered as an investment too. Offset’s Rings The Big Dollar Sign Ring The Big Dollar Sign Ring is a dollar sign made with all-white diamonds. Priced at $40,000, this ring can be seen on Offset’s finger during special occasions. Cuban Pinky Ring Like his many other counterparts, Offset also loves cuban rings. He has a small cuban pinky ring made of gold, which cost him $20,000. Conclusion Offset’s jewelry collection is just as rich as his music. The former Migos member is known for his trap style rapping and great voice. He influenced rap music in many ways, both as a rapper and a songwriter. From his jewelry collection, we can get an assurance that he has influenced modern hip hop fashion trends as well. Frequently Asked Questions How much is Offset’s Jewelry worth? Offset’s jewelry collection is estimated to be in the range of millions of dollars, considering the lavish designs and high-value materials. There is no exact confirmed valuation of his jewelry collection, as the rapper never mentioned the total value of his collection in public. However, a rough estimation is somewhere around 3 million. Who Designs Offset’s Jewelry? Offset’s jewelry collection boasts pieces from reputable luxury jewelers from the States and beyond. However, the former Migos rapper has a favorite when it comes to jewelers. Eliot Avianne is his favorite jeweler, who made some of his most popular jewelry pieces including the House Chain and the Raindrop Chain. Where Can I Find Offset’s Jewelry?
